snapshot_metadata.delta_summary: MAJOR: Claude Opus 4.8 released 2026-05-28 (3 days ago) — Opus 4.7 moved to Legacy. Opus 4.8 is back-compat with 4.7 (no breaking API changes). New capabilities: 1M context default with no beta header, mid-conversation system messages, lower 1024-token prompt-cache minimum, recalibrated effort levels. MINOR: Stainless acquired (likely SDK-tooling implications), $65B Series H, Milan office. Claude Code: Dispatch (phone-to-desktop session routing), --teleport flag, WinGet install.

claude-opus-4-8.tokenizer_note: Inherits Opus 4.7 tokenizer (~555k words per 1M tokens)
new_capabilities_vs_4_7: effort_levels_recalibrated (medium more thinking, high less, xhigh substantially more)
claude-opus-4-8.breaking_changes_vs_4_7: NONE — fully backwards compatible. Code on 4.7 runs unchanged on 4.8.

claude-opus-4-7.status_change_since_last_scan: still Active, but no longer top-billed model — Opus 4.8 is new primary

motoquant_current_routing.recommended_action: Queue [opportunistic] INSTRUCTION to switch default-Opus harness preference to claude-opus-4-8 on next session. Zero migration effort: no API calls in production code, no model IDs in agent prompts.

channels.note: Carried forward — Telegram → Channels as DISPATCH_INBOX.md alternative.

dispatch.description: Message a task from your phone, opens a Desktop session for it.
dispatch.relevance_to_motoquant: high (interesting overlap with MotoQuant's DISPATCH_INBOX.md naming and intent)
dispatch.rationale: User is on 8h internship and async-only. Dispatch lets the user fire a task from phone → automatic Claude Desktop session pickup. May supplement (or eventually subsume) DISPATCH_INBOX.md file polling. Evaluate UX on a real test before deciding.

teleport_flag.description: Pull a session started on web/iOS into terminal mid-flight.
teleport_flag.rationale: Niche workflow; user is single-environment most of the time.

winget_install.rationale: Install convenience only. No agent impact.

gitlab_ci_cd.rationale: MotoQuant is on GitHub. No relocation planned.

sub_agents.note: Carried forward — relevant to cleanup-rotation Sunday pass.

code_review_native.note: Carried forward — gate after pytest-regressions baseline.

mid_conversation_system_messages.rationale: Lets agents inject role:system after a user turn. Useful for the master_scheduler.sh → agent dispatch chain where we currently rebuild prompts to inject day-of-week / market-signal context. Preserves cache hits on earlier turns. Phase-6 consideration.

prompt_caching_lower_minimum.relevance_to_motoquant: low (CLAUDE.md alone is ~110KB / ~30k tokens, already well above either floor)
prompt_caching_lower_minimum.rationale: Smaller agent prompts (e.g. some scripts/agents/*.md files at ~500-1500 tokens) could newly create cache entries on 4.8. Marginal cost reduction.

effort_levels_recalibrated_opus_4_8.rationale: Default effort is high on 4.8. If session moves to 4.8, re-baseline cost vs intelligence at same level before adjusting.
